item.title: [7.2] Global Market: Eurozone bonds face pressure as energy shock fuels rate hike bets
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Eurozone bond yields rose sharply as energy-driven inflation strengthened expectations of further ECB rate hikes through 2027. French yields hit an 18-year high, while spreads for French and Italian debt widened amid fiscal concerns. Investors are reassessing inflation, borrowing costs, debt sustainability and political risks across heavily indebted eurozone economies.

WHY IT MATTERS

Rising eurozone yields and widening spreads signal growing stress on debt sustainability that warrants executive attention.

item.title: [6.7] Global Market: European shares slide as surging bond yields hit risk appetite
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

European shares opened the final quarter lower as elevated global bond yields and persistent inflation concerns weighed on investor sentiment. The STOXX 600 fell 1%, with banks among the biggest decliners. Higher energy costs and expectations of prolonged interest rates pressured equities, while softer oil prices offered limited relief to markets.

WHY IT MATTERS

The synchronized pressure of surging bond yields and inflation concerns opening the final quarter provides a useful macro baseline, though it largely reflects ongoing market trends.
